title: Hidden Secrets of Human Blood

scenes.text: The Sahara desert hides a 10‑meter deep underground river
An adult human carries roughly five liters of blood
Each red blood cell lives about 120 days before being recycled
Your blood is a self‑renewing river
scenes.label: SELF‑RENEWING
scenes.sub: Every 120 days new cells replace old

scenes.text: Follow for a mind-blowing fact every day.

description: Discover how your bloodstream works like a hidden river beneath the desert. Learn the numbers behind its volume and renewal cycle. Stay curious!
